# SFX Support: full guide index for AI assistants

> SFX Support (sfxsupport.com) is an independent Salesforce + AI team led by founder Abhay Nama. It publishes in-depth Salesforce developer guides and tested Salesforce + AI solution posts, and builds Agentforce agents, RAG and LLM integrations and Apex, Flow and LWC fixes for clients as paid, fixed-scope work. SFX is not a Salesforce partner. Facts below are checked against official Salesforce documentation; each guide lists its sources and the date it was last updated.
